scope: Synthetic data only; no real library/media/network/account/process
verified: Pinned default old vs latest new and explicit selected new
Logical binding slots preserved when physical slot differs
Asset four and Derivative six selected columns; deferred extras raiseload
Physical rowid ordered hydration; no per-work entity fetch
Product first-image fallback and motion source SHA gate
limits: No EXE or cold mechanical-disk latency claim
Full media path retained; compact media contract is page zero only
Up to480 union terms and480 physical row IDs per chunk; query count scales with actual chunks

queries.sql:
SELECT assets.rowid AS physical_row, ? AS owner, ? AS slot_role, ? AS slot_page 
FROM assets 
WHERE assets.work_id = ? AND assets.revision_id IS NULL AND assets.role = ? AND assets.page_index = ? UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT assets.rowid 
FROM assets 
WHERE assets.id = revision_assets.asset_id) AS physical_row, ? AS owner, revision_assets.role AS slot_role, revision_assets.page_index AS slot_page 
FROM revision_assets 
WHERE revision_assets.revision_id = ? AND revision_assets.role = ? AND revision_assets.page_index = ?
plan: COMPOUND QUERY
LEFT-MOST SUBQUERY
SEARCH assets USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_assets_2 (work_id=? AND revision_id=? AND role=? AND page_index=?)
UNION ALL
SEARCH revision_assets USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_revision_assets_1 (revision_id=? AND role=? AND page_index=?)
CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
SEARCH assets USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_assets_1 (id=?)
